n: Code.org AI and Machine Learning module
t: A middle school unit where students train a classifier on tabular data.
steps: Open the AI and Machine Learning course on Code.org Studio.
Check that the school allows Code.org.
Use a desktop or laptop for App Lab.
Decide whether students will sign in.
Try the AI Lab training steps yourself.
Preview the final project and plan the time it needs.
Compare the unit with the newer AI Discoveries course.
